post.summary: Sell something for Vibes as a developer app (Vibes Pay, D12).
post.description: **billing.vibes.charge** (public): Sell something for Vibes as a developer app (Vibes Pay, D12). POST /api/v1/vibes/charges creates a charge from the app's token (billing.vibes-charge-create-request@1; idempotent on the app's reference) and answers billing.vibes-charge@1 with a pay_url; GET /api/v1/vibes/charges/:id reads it; POST /api/v1/vibes/charges/:id/refund returns the Vibes from the project's Vibes wallet to the person (billing.vibes-charge-refund-request@1). The person pays on OpenVibe's pay sheet; Billing moves the Vibes atomically and once to the app's project Vibes wallet, then POSTs a signed webhook (HMAC-SHA256 with the app's webhook secret, retried with backoff) whose body is billing.vibes.charge.paid@1 or billing.vibes.charge.refunded@1 — no person id or email, only an opaque payer_ref stable per app. A sandbox app charges sandbox Vibes only (test grants, worth nothing). The owner's billing.vibes settings cap the amount, the daily per-person spend and whether Vibes Pay is on.

get.description: **billing.vibes.read** (public): Read a person's own Vibes as an app the person approved (D12): GET /api/v1/vibes/me with a person-delegated app token answers billing.vibes-wallet@1 — the Vibes to spend, the creator payable that can be cashed out (never into Balance) and today's bits_per_usd. The app sees only the person who approved it, never another person's Vibes.

post.description: **billing.credit.hold.create** (internal): Create an inference credit hold (D2): POST /internal/credits/holds. Service-authenticated; reserves up to max_nano_usd against a (subject, project_id) account.

post.description: **billing.credit.hold.extend** (internal): Extend an active inference hold (D2): POST /internal/credits/holds/:id/extend. Grows the held amount mid-stream; returns 402 billing.insufficient_funds if the balance is short.

post.description: **billing.credit.hold.release** (internal): Release a credit hold (D2): POST /internal/credits/holds/:id/release. Releases the remaining held amount with nothing charged.

post.summary: Settle a credit hold (D2): POST /internal/credits/holds/:id/settle.
post.description: **billing.credit.hold.settle** (internal): Settle a credit hold (D2): POST /internal/credits/holds/:id/settle. Records measured usage and the immutable retail rate version, charges the project account and releases the unused hold. Idempotent: replays return the same settlement.

post.description: **billing.credit.sandbox.grant** (internal): Grant synthetic credit to a (subject, project) for tests and staging (D9): POST /internal/credits/sandbox/grants. Refused unless BILLING_CREDITS_SANDBOX=1; a test transaction, never money.

billing.admin-request.v1.title: BillingAdminRequest
billing.admin-request.v1.description: billing.admin-request@1: bodies of billing.ledger.admin on OpenVibe.Billing (operators). POST /api/v1/admin/freeze: { on, reason? } (unfreezing processes the provider deliveries stored meanwhile; allowed while frozen). POST /api/v1/admin/adjustments: { from, to, amount, reason, relates_to? } moves value between two accounts of one currency. POST /api/v1/purchases/settle: { provider, provider_ref, subject?, amount_cents, bits, intent_id?, test? } books a provider receipt. POST /api/v1/admin/provider-events/:id/reprocess, POST /api/v1/admin/sweep and the GETs (freeze, reconcile, provider-events, import-holds) take no body. Adjustments and settlements need an Idempotency-Key and are refused while frozen.

billing.admin-result.v1.title: BillingAdminResult
billing.admin-result.v1.description: billing.admin-result@1: answers of billing.ledger.admin on OpenVibe.Billing. GET|POST /api/v1/admin/freeze → { frozen, reason, frozen_at, frozen_by } (POST adds processed_after_unfreeze); GET /api/v1/admin/reconcile → the reconciliation report { id, ok, trigger, started_at, finished_at, checks, warnings, totals }; POST /api/v1/admin/adjustments and POST /api/v1/purchases/settle → { transaction } (settle adds duplicate_receipt); GET /api/v1/admin/provider-events → { events }; POST …/provider-events/:id/reprocess → { event }; POST /api/v1/admin/sweep → { renewed, expired, canceled, skipped }; GET /api/v1/admin/import-holds → { holds }; GET /api/v1/usage → { records, next_cursor }.

principal.description: The service principal that recorded the reading

billing.balance-read-result.v1.title: BillingBalanceReadResult
billing.balance-read-result.v1.description: billing.balance-read-result@1: answers of billing.balance.read on OpenVibe.Billing. GET /api/v1/balances/:subject → billing.balance@1; GET /api/v1/transactions?subject=&limit=&cursor= → { transactions, next_cursor } (newest first, at most 200 a page; subject is required); GET /api/v1/transactions/:id → { transaction, reversed_by } (ids of the transactions that reverse it).

billing.balance.v1.title: BillingBalance
billing.balance.v1.description: billing.balance@1: a Balance account (D12), held by a person (owner user:<usr_id>) or a project (owner project:<prj_id>). GET /api/me/balance answers { personal, projects } of these. balance_nano_usd is the whole account; held_nano_usd is reserved by active holds; available_nano_usd is spendable (balance = held + available). Money is integer nano-USD as decimal strings (D1), never a float. sandbox marks a sandbox account. An id is permanent, so this contract still also describes the Vibes wallet body that billing.balance.read has answered: a person's Vibes (currency vibes-bits), not a Balance. Each branch is closed with additionalProperties: false; new code sends the Balance branch.

payable_value_cents.description: What payable is worth in US cents at today's rate.

money-nano-usd.description: Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a decimal string (D1), never a float.

oneOf.description: A person: usd_credit owned by user:<usr_id>.
A project: usd_credit owned by project:<prj_id>.

sandbox.description: True for a sandbox account (D10): sandbox credit only, never real money.

payable_value_cents.description: What payable is worth in US cents at today's rate.

billing.cashout-decision.v1.title: BillingCashoutDecision
billing.cashout-decision.v1.description: billing.cashout-decision@1: bodies of billing.cashout.manage on OpenVibe.Billing (staff). POST /api/v1/cashouts/:id/approve: { payout_reference, payout_provider? } after the payout was sent (payout_provider defaults to paypal; refused while the cashout is in escrow). POST /api/v1/cashouts/:id/deny: { reason? } returns the bits to the person's payable. GET /api/v1/cashouts takes no body. Every mutating call needs an Idempotency-Key header (a replay with the same key and body returns the first answer) and is refused with 503 billing.frozen while the economy is frozen. Refusals are problem+json (billing.invalid_input, billing.invalid_amount, billing.insufficient_funds, …).

billing.cashout-request.v1.title: BillingCashoutRequest
billing.cashout-request.v1.description: billing.cashout-request@1: bodies of billing.cashout.request on OpenVibe.Billing. POST /api/v1/cashouts: { subject, amount, payout_method: { type, address } } moves amount bits (at least the minimum cashout) from the person's payable into payouts pending, in escrow until staff pay it (a PayPal address must be an email). POST /api/v1/recycle: { subject, amount } turns payable back into the person's own spendable credit. GET /api/v1/cashouts/:id takes no body. Every mutating call needs an Idempotency-Key header (a replay with the same key and body returns the first answer) and is refused with 503 billing.frozen while the economy is frozen. Refusals are problem+json (billing.invalid_input, billing.invalid_amount, billing.insufficient_funds, …).

subject.description: A user SubjectRef, or its bare id (usr_…). Guests hold no money.
A user SubjectRef, or its bare id (usr_…). Guests hold no money.

billing.cashout-result.v1.title: BillingCashoutResult
billing.cashout-result.v1.description: billing.cashout-result@1: answers about cashouts on OpenVibe.Billing. POST /api/v1/cashouts (201), GET /api/v1/cashouts/:id, POST /api/v1/cashouts/:id/approve and /deny → { cashout }; GET /api/v1/cashouts?status=&subject=&limit= → { cashouts }; POST /api/v1/recycle (201) → { transaction, balance }. A cashout the Events stream carries names the payout method's type only; this API answers the caller who may see the address.

billing.cashout.v1.title: BillingCashout
billing.cashout.v1.description: billing.cashout@1: one cashout as OpenVibe.Billing presents it (server/ops/cashouts.js present). Requested cashouts wait out an escrow; staff approve (with the provider's payout reference) or deny them.

billing.credit-hold-create-request.v1.title: BillingCreditHoldCreateRequest
billing.credit-hold-create-request.v1.description: billing.credit-hold-create-request@1: body of POST /internal/credits/holds. Reserves inference credit up to max_nano_usd against a Balance account, priced at the given immutable rate version. With project_id the hold spends that project's Balance; without it the hold is personal and spends the subject's own Balance (D12). An app subject always names its project.

money-nano-usd.description: Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a string.

project_id.description: The project whose Balance the hold spends. Optional: without it the hold is personal, on the subject's own Balance. Required when the subject is an app.

service.description: Which metered service spends the credit (D9): ai, run, ... Defaults to ai.

sandbox.description: D10. A sandbox caller's hold draws on that person's sandbox credit for the project (account kind usd_credit_sandbox, owner subject:project), never on real Credits, and a real hold never draws on sandbox credit. Sandbox grants (billing.credit-sandbox-grant-request@1) land in that sandbox account. Optional; defaults to false.

billing.credit-hold-create-result.v1.title: BillingCreditHoldCreateResult
billing.credit-hold-create-result.v1.description: billing.credit-hold-create-result@1: response from POST /internal/credits/holds. Returns the created or replayed hold.

money-nano-usd.description: Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a string.

billing.credit-hold-extend-request.v1.title: BillingCreditHoldExtendRequest
billing.credit-hold-extend-request.v1.description: billing.credit-hold-extend-request@1: body of POST /internal/credits/holds/:id/extend. Grows an active hold by add_nano_usd.

money-nano-usd.description: Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a string.
Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a string.

billing.credit-hold-settle-request.v1.title: BillingCreditHoldSettleRequest
billing.credit-hold-settle-request.v1.description: billing.credit-hold-settle-request@1: body of POST /internal/credits/holds/:id/settle. Idempotent: the same key and fingerprint return the same settlement.

money-nano-usd.description: Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a string.
Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a string.

shortfall_nano_usd.description: Usage beyond the hold and the free balance: owed, not collected (nano-USD, D1).

billing.credit-sandbox-grant-request.v1.title: BillingCreditSandboxGrantRequest
billing.credit-sandbox-grant-request.v1.description: billing.credit-sandbox-grant-request@1: POST /internal/credits/sandbox/grants, synthetic credit for tests and staging. Billing answers only when BILLING_CREDITS_SANDBOX=1; the grant is a test transaction (D9). D10: the grant lands in the subject's sandbox credit account for the project (account kind usd_credit_sandbox, owner subject:project), and only a sandbox hold (billing.credit-hold-create-request@1 sandbox: true) draws on it; real Credits are never touched.

amount_nano_usd.description: Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a string.

billing.credit-sandbox-grant-result.v1.title: BillingCreditSandboxGrantResult
billing.credit-sandbox-grant-result.v1.description: billing.credit-sandbox-grant-result@1: the grant and the balance after it.

amount_nano_usd.description: Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a string.

balance_nano_usd.description: Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a string.

billing.entitlement-result.v1.title: BillingEntitlementResult
billing.entitlement-result.v1.description: billing.entitlement-result@1: answers of billing.entitlement.check on OpenVibe.Billing. GET /api/v1/entitlements/:subject?streamer= → billing.entitlement@1; without streamer → { subject, entitlements } (every active one); GET /api/v1/subscriptions → { subscriptions }; GET /api/v1/subscriptions/:id → { subscription, entitlement }.

billing.entitlement.v1.title: BillingEntitlement
billing.entitlement.v1.description: billing.entitlement@1: whether a person is entitled to a streamer's subscriber perks now (OpenVibe.Billing server/ops/subscriptions.js entitlement): GET /api/v1/entitlements/:subject?streamer=, and inside subscription answers. Chained, already-paid future periods extend expires_at.

tier.description: The subscription's tier (1 unless the creator sells tiers); null without a subscription.

billing.intent-request.v1.title: BillingIntentRequest
billing.intent-request.v1.description: billing.intent-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/intents on OpenVibe.Billing (billing.intent.create): a checkout with an enabled provider for a Vibes purchase ({ kind: purchase, bits } at least the minimum purchase) or a channel subscription ({ kind: subscription, streamer, tier? } at the tier's price; route direct pays the streamer's own account, and a direct PowerChat subscription names receiving_account). Billing prices it; the answer is { intent, checkout_url } (201). GET /api/v1/intents/:id and POST /api/v1/intents/:id/capture take no body. Every mutating call needs an Idempotency-Key header (a replay with the same key and body returns the first answer) and is refused with 503 billing.frozen while the economy is frozen. Refusals are problem+json (billing.invalid_input, billing.invalid_amount, billing.insufficient_funds, …).

provider.description: stripe, paypal, nowpayments, powerchat, ccbill (enabled ones only).

streamer.description: Subscription: the channel's owner (never the payer).

route.description: Subscription: direct, or the site route.

receiving_account.description: Direct PowerChat subscription: the streamer's PowerChat username.

tier.description: Subscription: the creator's tier (1 by default), priced by Billing (billing.tier.manage).

billing.intent-result.v1.title: BillingIntentResult
billing.intent-result.v1.description: billing.intent-result@1: answers of billing.intent.create on OpenVibe.Billing. POST /api/v1/intents → { intent, checkout_url } (null when the provider has no hosted checkout); GET /api/v1/intents/:id → { intent }; POST /api/v1/intents/:id/capture → { result, intent } (the settlement the provider's capture produced).

result.description: Capture: what applying the provider's plan did.

billing.intent.v1.title: BillingIntent
billing.intent.v1.description: billing.intent@1: a checkout intent as OpenVibe.Billing presents it (server/ops/intents.js present): what a person is about to pay a provider for (a Vibes purchase or a channel subscription), priced by Billing.

checkout_ref.description: PowerChat only: pcorder:<id> or pcsub:<id>, echoed back by its webhook.

billing.stats-result.v1.title: BillingStatsResult
billing.stats-result.v1.description: billing.stats-result@1: GET /api/v1/stats on OpenVibe.Billing (billing.stats.read, ?days=1..90, default 30). Counts with no person in them. purchases: Vibes bought with money (settled purchase transactions, test ones left out): bits_total all time, windows d/w/m (the last 1, 7 and 30 days) and pw (the 7 days before the last 7), series [{ day, value }] per UTC day over `days`. subscriptions: active now, started in the windows (paid first periods, renewals not counted) and per day. as_of is when the counts were taken.

billing.subscription-request.v1.title: BillingSubscriptionRequest
billing.subscription-request.v1.description: billing.subscription-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/subscriptions on OpenVibe.Billing (billing.subscription.manage): pay one period of subscriber → streamer, from the subscriber's credit (source credit, the default) or from a provider receipt (source receipt, which also needs billing.ledger.admin: claiming money was received is operator grade). POST /api/v1/subscriptions/:id/cancel (cancels at the period end, with the provider too) and the GETs take no body. Every mutating call needs an Idempotency-Key header (a replay with the same key and body returns the first answer) and is refused with 503 billing.frozen while the economy is frozen. Refusals are problem+json (billing.invalid_input, billing.invalid_amount, billing.insufficient_funds, …).

subscriber.description: A user SubjectRef, or its bare id (usr_…). Guests hold no money.

streamer.description: A user SubjectRef, or its bare id (usr_…). Guests hold no money.

tier.description: The creator's tier (1 by default): a credit-paid period costs the tier's price (billing.tier.manage); a renewal keeps the price the subscription was bought at.

billing.subscription-result.v1.title: BillingSubscriptionResult
billing.subscription-result.v1.description: billing.subscription-result@1: answers about subscriptions on OpenVibe.Billing. POST /api/v1/subscriptions (201) → { subscription, entitlement, transaction }; POST /api/v1/subscriptions/:id/cancel → { subscription, provider_sync }; GET /api/v1/subscriptions?subscriber=&streamer=&status= → { subscriptions }; GET /api/v1/subscriptions/:id → { subscription, entitlement }.

entitlement.description: billing.entitlement@1 (the answer to POST /subscriptions carries the entitlement as booked).

provider_sync.description: not_needed, or how the provider was told.

billing.subscription.v1.title: BillingSubscription
billing.subscription.v1.description: billing.subscription@1: one channel subscription as OpenVibe.Billing presents it (server/ops/subscriptions.js present).

provider.description: credit, or the provider that takes the payments.

route.description: site or direct (paid to the streamer's own provider account).

status.description: active, past_due (a failed renewal, retried until grace_until), canceled, expired, …

billing.tier-request.v1.title: BillingTierRequest
billing.tier-request.v1.description: billing.tier-request@1: the body of PUT /api/v1/tiers/:streamer/:tier on OpenVibe.Billing (billing.tier.manage): the monthly price of one of a creator's subscription tiers (1 to max_tiers), which the creator chooses on the product that sells it (OpenVibe.VIP) and Billing keeps and charges (ADR-012: Billing prices, products never do). price_cents must be within Billing's bounds (min_price_cents to max_price_cents, from GET /api/v1/tiers/:streamer or /api/v1/rates). status archived stops new subscriptions to the tier; running ones renew at the price they were bought at. A tier without a row: tier 1 is sold at the site's default subscription price, any other tier is refused (billing.tier_unknown). GET /api/v1/tiers/:streamer takes no body. The PUT needs an Idempotency-Key header and is refused with 503 billing.frozen while the economy is frozen.

status.description: active (the default) sells the tier; archived sells it no more.

billing.tier-result.v1.title: BillingTierResult
billing.tier-result.v1.description: billing.tier-result@1: answers of billing.tier.manage on OpenVibe.Billing. GET /api/v1/tiers/:streamer → { streamer, tiers, default_price_cents, min_price_cents, max_price_cents, max_tiers } (tiers: every tier with a price, archived included; tier 1 without a row is sold at default_price_cents); PUT /api/v1/tiers/:streamer/:tier → { tier }.

billing.transaction.v1.title: BillingTransaction
billing.transaction.v1.description: billing.transaction@1: one journal transaction as OpenVibe.Billing's /api/v1 presents it (server/ledger.js present). Amounts are integers: bits for vibes-bits, cents for usd-cents; each transaction's entries balance per currency. Subjects are bare Network subject ids.

receipt_ref.description: <provider>:<provider payment id> for money that arrived from a provider.

metadata.description: Per type: amount_bits, paid_cents, target EntityRef, message, rates…

owner.description: A subject id, a provider slug, or null for a platform account.

billing.transfer-request.v1.title: BillingTransferRequest
billing.transfer-request.v1.description: billing.transfer-request@1: bodies of billing.transfer.create on OpenVibe.Billing. POST /api/v1/transfers: { from, to, amount, kind?, target?, message? } moves amount bits from the sender's credit to the recipient's payable (a tip, donation or paid interaction; never to oneself). POST /api/v1/transfers/:id/refund: { amount?, reason? } gives a credit-funded donation back (all that remains refundable when amount is absent). Every mutating call needs an Idempotency-Key header (a replay with the same key and body returns the first answer) and is refused with 503 billing.frozen while the economy is frozen. Refusals are problem+json (billing.invalid_input, billing.invalid_amount, billing.insufficient_funds, …).

target.description: What the money is for (a stream, a paid message, …).

amount.description: Bits to give back; default all that remains refundable.

billing.transfer-result.v1.title: BillingTransferResult
billing.transfer-result.v1.description: billing.transfer-result@1: answers of billing.transfer.create on OpenVibe.Billing (201). POST /api/v1/transfers → { transaction, balance: { credit } } (the sender's credit after it); POST /api/v1/transfers/:id/refund → { transaction } (type refund, reverses_txn the donation).

billing.usage-record-result.v1.title: BillingUsageRecordResult
billing.usage-record-result.v1.description: billing.usage-record-result@1: answer of billing.usage.record on OpenVibe.Billing. POST /api/v1/usage → { record } (201 when stored; 200 with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` when the same reading was already stored under its idempotency_key). Storing a reading charges nothing.

principal.description: The service principal that recorded the reading

billing.vibes-charge-create-request.v1.title: BillingVibesChargeCreateRequest
billing.vibes-charge-create-request.v1.description: billing.vibes-charge-create-request@1: body of POST /api/v1/vibes/charges, sent from the app's server with its app token (capability billing.vibes.charge). amount is whole Vibes. reference is the app's idempotency key: a replay with the same reference and body returns the same charge. return_url is optional. The app token decides the project, the sandbox environment and the owner-set limits.

amount.description: Price in whole Vibes, a positive integer; never a fraction or a nano-USD amount.

description.description: What the person is paying for.

reference.description: The app's own reference; it is the idempotency key.

return_url.description: Where the browser returns after paying. Optional; the app may instead poll the charge or wait for the webhook.

billing.vibes-charge.v1.title: BillingVibesCharge
billing.vibes-charge.v1.description: billing.vibes-charge@1: one Vibes Pay charge (D12). An app creates it for a person to pay with Vibes; GET /api/v1/vibes/charges/:id answers it, and a replay of the same app reference returns the same charge. amount is a whole number of Vibes (never a fraction, never nano-USD). status moves pending -> paid -> refunded, or pending -> expired|cancelled. sandbox charges use test Vibes only, worth nothing. The paid and refunded webhook/event payloads carry the same fields plus an opaque payer_ref and no person id or email.

app.description: The app that created the charge (its app_ id).

project_id.description: The app's project; paid Vibes land in that project's Vibes wallet.

amount.description: Price in whole Vibes. A positive integer; Vibes have no fractions.

description.description: What the person is paying for.

reference.description: The app's own reference for this charge. It is the idempotency key: a replay with the same reference returns the same charge.

pay_url.description: OpenVibe's pay sheet for this charge, e.g. https://openvibe.network/pay/vch_...

return_url.description: Where the browser returns after paying; null when the app gave no return URL.

paid_at.description: When the Vibes moved, or null while the charge is unpaid.

refunded_at.description: When the Vibes went back to the person, or null.

expires_at.description: The pay sheet stops accepting payment after this instant.

sandbox.description: True for a sandbox app: sandbox Vibes only, worth nothing.

billing.vibes-wallet.v1.title: BillingVibesWallet
billing.vibes-wallet.v1.description: billing.vibes-wallet@1: a person's own Vibes, answered by GET /api/v1/vibes/me (capability billing.vibes.read) to an app the person approved. credit is Vibes to spend; payable is Vibes the person received as a creator and may cash out under the payout rules (never into Balance); bits_per_usd is today's rate. Vibes are whole integers; this is not a Balance and carries no nano-USD.

subject.description: The person the app reads for (the approved delegation). Only a user, never an app or a service.

payable.description: Vibes received as a creator, to cash out; never Balance.

bits_per_usd.description: Today's Vibes per USD rate, the same one a pack is priced with.

common.config-change.v1.title: ConfigChange
common.config-change.v1.description: common.config-change@1 (AI Exchange D11): body of POST /internal/config/:namespace on a service's openvibe-shared/config admin routes. It proposes a new revision of the namespace and activates it (the store validates against the namespace schema, applies env pins and calls onActivate). `merge: true` starts from the active values; otherwise `values` is the whole new set. `unset` removes keys. A secret-class key's value is never sent here: it is 422 config.secret_write_only; use common.config-secret-put@1.

values.description: The new values, one member per key. The store validates them against the namespace schema; a secret-class value here is refused.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value; a redaction marker keeps the value it stands for.

reason.description: Why the change is made; it is the revision's reason in the history.

merge.description: Merge into the active values instead of replacing them.

unset.description: Keys to remove from the new revision.

common.config-namespace.v1.title: ConfigNamespace
common.config-namespace.v1.description: common.config-namespace@1 (AI Exchange D11): one service configuration namespace as openvibe-shared/config's summary() returns it (config-pg.js), plus `sealed`, `pins` and `schema`. GET /internal/config lists these for a service and GET /internal/config/:namespace returns one. Values are the active ones over the defaults, with every secret-class value replaced by its marker; a marker never carries the value. `sealed` says whether the service has a KEK so secrets are envelopes (false is the pre-D11 plaintext behaviour). `pins` names the keys whose x-env variable is set, so their effective value is the environment's and a write is 409 config.pinned_in_env. `schema` is the namespace's JSON Schema so a client can draw the form; its annotations are title, description, x-group, x-env, x-danger, x-bind and x-unit (nano_usd, ms, bps).

revision.description: The active revision; null before the namespace has one.

values.description: The active values over the defaults, one member per key. A secret-class key's value is a marker, never the value.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value. An object with a redacted member is a secret marker, and nothing else.

classification.description: Every key of values, classified. A key the service does not classify is internal.

sealed.description: True when the service has a KEK: secret-class values are stored as envelopes and only opened for a caller that needs them. False keeps the pre-D11 plaintext-inside-values_json behaviour, and the tab shows it in red.

pins.description: The keys whose x-env variable is set in the service process: their effective value is the environment's, read-only, and a write answers 409 config.pinned_in_env.

schema.description: The namespace's JSON Schema, or null when it has none. Annotations the client may read: title, description, x-group, x-env, x-danger, x-bind (the key whose value the secret is bound to) and x-unit (nano_usd, ms or bps).

active.description: The active revision as a snapshot (common.config-snapshot@1), or null.

last_known_good.description: The last revision that activated cleanly (common.config-snapshot@1), or null.

marker.description: A secret-class value, as the summary and the secret endpoints show it: never the value. The fingerprint is keyed, so equal fingerprints within one namespace mean the value did not change.

fingerprint.description: HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of the value, keyed with the namespace's secret key.

hint.description: The four-character hint (the value's last four characters), never more.

bound_to.description: The value of the key named by x-bind when the secret was set, e.g. a provider base_url origin.

common.config-snapshot.v1.title: ConfigSnapshot
common.config-snapshot.v1.description: One immutable revision of one service's configuration namespace (roadmap WS-C task 7; kept by openvibe-shared/config). A revision's values never change: revisions grow by one per namespace, and a rollback is a new revision that copies an older one's values. Only the state moves: proposed -> active -> superseded or rolled_back, or proposed -> rejected when validation or activation fails, in which case the previous active revision stays or is restored. A secret-class key's value never appears here: it is { redacted: true, fingerprint }, an HMAC-SHA256 of the value under a secret key the service keeps per namespace, so equal fingerprints within one namespace mean the value did not change, while the value cannot be recovered or guessed offline without that key. checksum is the sha256 of the canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace) of values exactly as they appear here, secrets as their markers, so anyone can check it, and two snapshots of one namespace with the same checksum hold the same configuration.

previous_revision.description: The revision that was active when this one was proposed; null for the namespace's first.

values.description: The configuration, one member per key. A secret-class key's value is a redaction marker.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value. An object with a redacted member is a redaction marker, and nothing else.

fingerprint.description: HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of the value, keyed with the namespace's secret key: equal within one namespace when the value is unchanged, and not recoverable or guessable without the key.

classification.description: Every key of values, classified. A key the service does not classify is internal.

checksum.description: sha256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of values as they appear in this snapshot (secrets as their markers).

activated_at.description: When it became active; null while proposed, and for a rejected revision.

error.description: Why it was rejected: the validation errors, or what activation reported. Never a secret value.

copied_from.description: A rollback's source: the revision whose values this one copies.

common.entity-ref.v1.title: EntityRef
common.entity-ref.v1.description: Typed reference to another service's entity. Store this instead of a foreign key; resolve a display projection from the owner.

common.no-body.v1.title: NoBody
common.no-body.v1.description: common.no-body@1: the capability's request carries no body; its parameters are the path and query of the routes in implementedBy (an id, a page cursor). An input schema that says so explicitly, so every active capability names one (roadmap WS-C task 4).

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

identity.subject-ref.v1.title: SubjectRef
identity.subject-ref.v1.description: The one cross-platform reference to an actor. Issued by OpenVibe.Network. Never a service-local integer id.

oneOf.description: AgentSubject: an agent (OpenVibe.Actor, or a developer app's agent) acting under grants its owner delegated (roadmap WS-Z2). In an event envelope, on_behalf_of names the owner.

platform.usage-sample.v1.title: UsageSample
platform.usage-sample.v1.description: One metered usage reading with retry-safe attribution (T1 Universal Fabric; ADR-034 proposed). Consumers dedupe on `idempotency_key`. A running platform.job@1 `function` job is one reading per wall-clock second (service `run`, operation `function.invoke`, unit `s`, idempotency_key `run:<job id>:<second>`), derived as platform.job-frame@1 `job_usage` describes.
platform.usage-sample.v1.$comment: Additive optional fields may extend this v1 contract.

idempotency_key.description: Stable across retries. The only dedupe key, and it encodes work identity only (examples: tools:job:<id>, ai:<run>:tokens, run:<job>:<n>), never route_epoch, node, region or trace_id.

service.description: The Contracts manifest id of the producing service (tools, ai, run).

resource.description: The producing service's billing resource: the platform.rate-card@1 `metric` for this reading's `provider` (e.g. `tokens`, `queue-operation-64kb`), and never a run, job, object or other work id. The reading's `unit` must be that metric's unit, so Billing rates it against the card found by (provider, resource): a resource that names no card, or a unit the card's metric does not fit, is left unrated (`billing.no_card` / `billing.unit_mismatch`).

free_allowance_used.description: How much of this reading's `quantity` the free allowance covered (platform.rate-card@1 `free_allowance` for this provider/metric and period), in the reading's own `unit`, not in rate-card units, money or Vibes: a 1.5 GiB reading with 1 GiB free carries 1. Never more than `quantity`; 0 when nothing was free. Absent: not rated against a rate card.

vibes_charged.description: Vibes charged for this reading, as an integer count of vibes-bits (Billing's ledger minor unit, currency `vibes-bits`; balance credit and ledger amounts use the same unit). Never whole Vibes, USD or a fraction: round once, when rating. Covers only `quantity` minus `free_allowance_used`; 0 means rated and nothing charged. Absent means not rated (yet). Records a charge already made in Billing's ledger; it is never a request to charge.

route_epoch.description: Epoch of the signed placement plan that chose where this reading ran (platform.placement-plan@1 `epoch`). A later plan supersedes it; absent when Fabric did not place the work.

trace_id.description: Opaque trace id tying this reading to the request and route that produced it, the same `trace_id` platform.telemetry-sample@1 carries; absent when the producer had no trace.

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
